Fact: PPFAS publishes a monthly factsheet for all its schemes, archived by month on the AMC's factsheet page. Scheme performance, NAV, AUM and portfolio details are disclosed there.

Fact: Changes to a PPFAS scheme's load structure, minimum amounts or other features are notified through addenda published on the AMC's Notices and Addenda page. Check it if a figure quoted from a factsheet looks out of date.

Scheme: All PPFAS schemes
Topic: Nav
Keywords: nav net asset value daily price unit price latest today where published
Fact: Daily NAV per unit for every PPFAS plan and option is published by the AMC, and the month-end NAV of each plan is printed in the monthly factsheet. This assistant does not quote or track NAV values.

Scheme: All PPFAS schemes
Topic: Aum
Keywords: aum assets under management fund size aaum how big corpus
Fact: AUM and average AUM for each PPFAS scheme are disclosed month by month in the AMC's monthly factsheet. This assistant does not quote AUM figures, because they change every month.

Scheme: All PPFAS schemes
Topic: Entry load
Keywords: entry load charged on purchase upfront commission
Fact: No PPFAS scheme charges an entry load; entry load has been Not Applicable since the SEBI circular dated June 30, 2009, effective August 1, 2009. Investors may pay commission to their distributor directly.
